name: devops ci cd
rules: Keep build, delivery and quality commands reproducible, explicit and aligned with repository policy.
Treat optional infrastructure checks as optional and report unavailable checks without weakening required gates.
Keep credentials, generated artifacts and environment-specific assumptions out of reusable delivery semantics.
verification: Identify the applicable build, test, lint, architecture and packaging checks for the change.
Review pipeline results and confirm skipped or failed checks have an explicit reason.
